rows.verdict: Corvo stands planted, armed and then holstered (upright, arms down); the holster ends and the redraw starts without a pop at 15 fps.
Emily holds her idle unarmed, then draws into her wide armed stance continuously at 15 fps.
Corvo's armed idle holds the sword low and settles after each stop.
Emily's armed idle keeps her wide ready stance after the redraw.
Corvo walks with alternating strides in every heading.
Emily walks with alternating strides, coat swinging, sword in hand, in every heading.
Emily runs with extended strides in each heading and changes direction without pops.
Corvo runs in each heading with a distinct run stride.
Emily sprints with long forward-leaning strides and pumping arms, ending close to the observer.
Emily starts into stride and stops planted between segments.
The ramp blends walk into run into sprint without a pop.
Corvo steps his feet through the 180 degree turns and faces about.
Corvo's crouched turns stay low with stepping feet, no upright flashes.
Emily's crouched turns stay low with stepping feet, no upright flashes.
Corvo walks, runs and sprints through right-hand arcs with the body following the curve; the run arc ends close to the camera in a planted stop.
Corvo walks forward and backward through the moving turns with his body following the curve and legs in stride.
Emily's direction changes at run speed blend without pops.
Corvo walks away up the sloped cobbled street beside the tram rails, then turns and walks back down toward the camera.
Emily walks away up the same street, then comes back down toward the camera, stepping on the incline throughout.
Corvo steps down the staircase with alternating feet, sword in hand.
Emily climbs the staircase stepping, upright.
Corvo holds a low crouch between crouched moves.
Emily holds a planted crouch while still.
Corvo crouch-walks in a low stepping posture in every heading.
Emily's crouches blend continuously, still and moving.
Emily rises continuously into a planted stand.
Corvo's crouched turns stay low with stepping feet.
Emily's crouched turns stay low with stepping feet.
Corvo's crouched starts and stops are clean into a held crouch.
Corvo's standing leans shift the whole body sideways over planted feet and recover (modest amplitude).
Emily's standing leans shift visibly each way and recover.
Corvo's crouched leans are clear both ways and recover.
Emily's crouched leans are clear both ways and recover.
Corvo's crouched peek rises clearly; the standing peek is a subtle tiptoe rise.
Emily's crouched peek rises clearly; the standing peek is a subtle tiptoe rise.
Corvo bends to the keyhole at the door, holds, and rises back on exit, standing and crouched.
Emily bends to the keyhole, holds, and rises back on exit, standing and crouched.
Corvo takes off from a planted idle, tucks, lands with a compression and recovers, armed and holstered.
Emily runs into the jump, carries through the air toward the camera and keeps running.
Corvo jumps from the crouch, tucks and lands back into the crouch.
Corvo springs from a crouched take-off, tucks, kicks into a second tuck near the top and comes down arms spread into a compressed crouched landing, then recovers.
Emily takes off, tucks with her coat flaring, tucks again for the second impulse and lands in a crouch before standing.
The ascent pose extends, then tucks with height.
Corvo drops from height in the falling pose and lands.
Each landing compresses and recovers to a planted idle.
Corvo drops onto the dock and lands in a deep crouch with one hand on the planks, holds it a moment, rises and walks on.
Emily lands from the fall in the same braced crouch, pushes up and walks away along the dock.
Emily lands from the run jump into a continuing stride.
Seen side-on, Corvo runs in, goes over the obstacle airborne with legs tucked and carries on.
Seen side-on, Emily vaults the obstacle the same way.
Emily jumps, reaches up and pulls onto the canopy, then stands on top.
The grab and pull-up read as a reach and climb onto the ledge.
Emily steps up to the window, plants her hands on the sill, swings through the opening and drops out of sight on the far side.
Emily sprints, drops into the slide and jumps out of it; the second slide enters low.
The slide recovers into a crouch, and the jump exit lands standing.
Emily enters the climb from the street, ascends to the top and exits by letting go.
Corvo grabs the chain at the street, pulls himself up hand over hand, then climbs back down and steps off.
Emily climbs the chain all the way up, hangs at the top and lets go.
From behind, Emily strokes away through the murky water, slips under and surfaces again, then treads water with her arms out.
Corvo swims up to the dock edge, pulls himself up onto it in one movement, stands and steps forward.

Corvo, crouched, takes the hand to the hip and puts the sword away, holds an unarmed crouched idle, then draws it again; walking, he holsters into an unarmed arm swing and later walks on with the sword drawn.
Emily lands from each jump strike and settles into the standing sword-ready idle, blade low at her side, before the next jump.
Corvo throws the single slash and the three-hit combo from the armed stance, his torso turning into each cut, then settles.
Corvo winds the heavy attack back and lunges with a wide step; crouched, the heavy stays low through the lunge and he recovers crouched.
Corvo slashes while stepping forward, sidestepping right past the camera and backing away, and swings in a running stride; the legs keep the gait under each strike.
Corvo strikes from the crouch with the arm extended and lunges low for the crouched heavy, staying crouched, then stands.
Emily leaps with her legs tucked and slashes at the top of the jump, lands with the blade still out and recovers to the ready idle.
Emily raises the guard standing, again from the crouch (staying crouched), and once more at the top of a jump, lowering it on landing.
Backed against the wall, Corvo snaps his sword up overhead to meet the guard's swing; the guard is thrown off balance and stumbles back.
Emily raises her blade across her body each time the guard swings and holds her ground.
After the parry Corvo lowers the blade back to his guard stance and steps in to attack again.
From above the street: the guard lunges, Emily catches him and the two lock together through the finisher, and he drops as other guards close in.
From above the street: Corvo parries the guard's swing, steps in and drives his sword forward into him with the arm fully extended, and the guard falls back onto the street.
Left (variant 3): the blast from her left flings Emily away from the camera; she staggers with her arms out and recovers upright.
Front (variant 2): facing the camera, Emily reels back from the blast in front of her with her arms flung out, then steadies and stands.
Right (variant 1): thrown toward the camera, she staggers, drops low with one arm out and recovers.
Back (variant 4): the blast behind her throws Emily toward the camera; she stumbles forward and recovers standing.
Left (variant 3): the blast from his left flings Corvo away from the camera; he lands in a crouched stagger with his arms out and straightens up.
Front (variant 2): facing the camera, Corvo is thrown back, staggers with his arms out and recovers his stance.
Right (variant 1): thrown toward the camera, Corvo staggers low with his arms out and straightens up.
Back (variant 4): the blast behind him pitches Corvo forward toward the camera; he stumbles bent over and recovers.
Emily recoils, drops to her knees, lies face down, pushes up to a crouch and rises to her guard.
Corvo drops to his knees, lies face down, pushes up to a crouch and rises to standing.
From behind her inside the room: Emily swings at the wall, her arms fly out wide and her body is thrown back off the blow, then she recovers to her guard.
From behind him inside the room: Corvo swings at the wall, his sword arm is flung back, his body twists and he stumbles back a step before recovering.

Corvo's window, from the walkway west of the railing: Emily, crouched in front of the guard, rises into a high kick to his chest; he reels back against the railing, then draws and fights her. Natural full-body kick. Accepted.
(Reviewed for audit v1356.) Corvo bursts out of the blink right at the guard with his arms flung wide and one leg driving forward in the kick, then lands and straightens in the dispersing smoke.
Corvo reels back from the guard's blow against the bookshelf and drops onto his back across the book stacks, staying down.
Emily is struck, staggers back and folds to the floor beside the book stacks while the guard stands over her.
The guard seizes Corvo and stabs him while he stands held; Corvo sinks to his knees, falls forward and lies face down before GameOver.

The guard grabs Emily, who stands held while he strikes, then staggers and sinks to her knees; on 1214cw GameOver removed her before she lay down. 1214cx starts the finisher collapse 0.4 s earlier, which 1361q and 1361s verify on Corvo (down before GameOver); the timing path is the same for both roles. On 1214cy the guard in the joiner world is a host-driven replica, so her deaths arrive as relayed hits (plain death, 1361t-v).
Corvo falls from above onto the guard, drives him down and rises with the sword raised over the body.
Emily lands behind the guard from above and he crumples forward onto the floor; she straightens over the body.
Corvo drops onto the guard; the body slumps out of the takedown into a sprawl on the floorboards and lies still, ending 2 cm from the host body.
Emily lands on the guard and drives him face down at her feet; the body then slackens and rolls into a sprawl beside her and stays down, ending 0.37 m from the same body in the joiner world.
Corvo raises the pistol at arm's length for each shot, lowers it to reload, puts it away and draws it again.
Corvo extends the wrist crossbow and holds it level for each bolt, recocks between shots, then lowers the arm to holster and raises it again.
Corvo holds the crossbow aimed through the dart selection, raises it to fire a dart, re-aims after switching back and finally lowers his arm to holster.
Emily draws her arm back over her shoulder with the grenade, steps into the throw with her coat swinging, and recovers to the armed stance.
Corvo looks down, bends and reaches toward the floor to set the mine, then straightens.
Corvo lifts the Heart in his left hand in front of his chest, holds it there, and lowers it again.
Emily brings her hand up to her mouth to drink, holds it briefly and lowers it.
Emily thrusts her hand out to cast Mesmerize, the spirit forms above her, then she turns and lifts her hand to her mouth to drink before lowering it.
Emily raises the pistol, swaps to the wrist crossbow without lowering her arm fully, drops the arm when Blink is selected, then raises the crossbow again and puts it away.

Emily grabs the guard from his right; he folds and drops to the floor at her feet.
Corvo walks up to the guard face to face, grabs him and drives him down; the guard sinks at his feet and Corvo straightens with the sword raised.
Emily steps in to the guard standing and drives into him from the front; he goes down at her feet and she stands over the body.

Corvo grabs the guard from the right, holds the choke while the guard kicks, and lowers him.
Emily steps in from the guard's right and chokes him; he folds to the floor beside her.
Corvo seizes the guard face to face; the guard sinks to the floor in front of him (partly hidden behind Corvo).
Emily faces the guard, seizes him and holds the choke, then lowers him to the floor.
Corvo comes in low from the guard's side, drives the blade in and the guard folds to the floor of the walkway.
Emily closes on the guard from the side on the balcony and stabs him; he drops and she straightens over the body.
Corvo falls from above onto the guard, drives him down and rises with the sword raised over the body.
Emily lands behind the guard from above and he crumples forward onto the floor; she straightens over the body.

Emily's outside camera: Corvo seizes the overseer from behind through the window, hauls him back over the sill and drives the blade in (assassination_window_back). Accepted.

Corvo's window: Emily grabs the tall overseer from behind, holds him while he struggles and he goes down behind the stone block. Accepted.

Accepted for the source's presentation; the seated victim's pose in the partner's world is #113 (stage 4).

Corvo's window: Emily's replica stands beside the armchair in the choke posture through her native choke_sit_left; the unstreamed servant stays seated, her head dropping with the unconscious outcome. Accepted for the source's presentation; the victim's pose is #113 (stage 4).
Corvo grabs the guard from behind and holds the choke while the guard struggles; the guard sags and collapses at his feet in the same place.

Accepted.

Natural full-body breakout matching choke_combat_lose. Accepted.
Emily bends over the choked guard, reaches down and rises with him over her shoulder, then stands with him (backlit, silhouette).
Corvo bends over the guard lying at his feet, gathers him up and rises with him on his shoulder, then stands with the body on the shoulder.

Corvo throws his left arm out to aim, drops it again at the cancel and stays where he stands; a few seconds later he aims again and vanishes in a blue burst.

Corvo raises his left hand palm-out for the cast, holds it for about half a second and lowers it with the sword still in his right hand; the second press ends the power with the same gesture, and he settles back into his standing idle each time.

A dark mass of rats spreads over the floor ahead of Corvo for about a second and disperses.
From behind, Emily reaches her left hand down the lane, is pulled off her feet with the tether light at her hand, flies about ten metres and lands at the far end.

Emily reaches out with her left hand and holds it, lowers it again without moving when the aim is cancelled, then reaches once more and is pulled away down the lane; the scene is dim but the poses read.

Corvo's window: Emily raises her left arm and holds the Far Reach aim in a braced stance, the tendril lashes out from her hand, then she draws the arm back sharply with her body leaning into the pull and recovers to her stance. Natural full-body pull. Accepted (the pulled bottle moves only in her world, #115).
Emily lifts her hand to her face to cast and again to end Dark Vision, sword held low, then settles.

On the upper floor Emily throws her hand toward the guard and a golden mark flares on him; downstairs she casts at the second guard and a bright golden link beam runs up to the first, staying in place while she aims once more and lowers her hand.
A bright summon burst rises beside Emily; a second Emily appears next to her, runs off, and is gone about two seconds later while Emily stands armed.
Emily thrusts her hand forward; a dark, tendrilled spirit forms a few metres ahead of her and hovers there for the rest of the cast.

Emily drops from standing into the Shadow Walk crawl and becomes a matte black silhouette with the native smoke around her, crawls forward on all fours, then rises and is back in her ordinary colours as the form ends.

From the form behind the guard, Emily as a black silhouette seizes him and throws him overhead; he crashes down dead and she straightens in her ordinary colours. Her sword's ring guard stays lit in her hand during the throw (the sword is a separate entity outside the material).
From the form, Emily as a black silhouette pulls the guard down to his knees from behind, then holds him down in her ordinary colours until he goes limp.
Emily's window: Corvo drops in and lands crouched inside a large swirling wind blast while a wave runs along the floor around him. Accepted.
Emily's window: Corvo thrusts his hand out and heavy white wind streaks fly from it, wider than the plain blast. Accepted.

Corvo's window: Emily casts, the first shade appears beside her and walks off, she turns and casts again and the second shade rises in smoke; both are shown at once (status). Accepted.
Corvo's window: Emily casts, the shade rises, and she reappears at the shade's place. Accepted.

Emily's window: Corvo thrusts his arm toward the guard and vanishes; only the guard is seen, then Corvo reappears beside him (audit v1341). Accepted.
Emily twists slightly and flicks her left hand at the hip, the native out-of-mana response, then settles.
Corvo flicks his left hand out at the hip with the native out-of-mana wisps curling around it, then the hand drops back.
